```python
def merge(self, ranges, gap=0):
    if not ranges: return []
    rs = sorted((min(lo,hi), max(lo,hi)) for lo,hi in ranges)
    merged = [list(rs[0])]
    for lo,hi in rs[1:]:
        last = merged[-1]
        if lo - last[1] - 1 <= gap:
            if hi > last[1]: last[1] = hi
        else:
            merged.append([lo,hi])
    return [(l,h) for l,h in merged]
```

```python
class Impl:
    def parse(self, argv):
        values = {}
        flags = {}
        positional = []
        i = 0
        n = len(argv)
        only_positional = False

            arg = argv[i]
            if only_positional:
                positional.append(arg)
                i += 1
                continue
            if arg == "--":
                only_positional = True
                i += 1
                continue
            if arg.startswith("--"):
                body = arg[2:]
                if "=" in body:
                    key, val = body.split("=", 1)
                    values.setdefault(key, []).append(val)
                    i += 1
                    continue
                key = body
                # check next
                if i+1 < n and not argv[i+1].startswith("--"):
                    values.setdefault(key, []).append(argv[i+1])
                    i += 2
                else:
                    flags[key] = True
                    i += 1
                continue
            if arg.startswith("-") and arg != "-":
                # bundled short switches
                for ch in arg[1:]:
                    flags[ch] = True
                i += 1
                continue
            # positional
            positional.append(arg)
            i += 1
        return {"values": values, "flags": flags, "positional": positional}
```

```python
class Impl:
    def merge(self, ranges):
        if not ranges: return []
        rs = sorted((min(lo,hi), max(lo,hi)) for lo,hi in ranges)
```
